meta.note: Keyed register > question id, mirroring reviews/data/samples.json so the sample page needs no genre-specific reader — with the register as an extra top level, matching every other email file. Each record holds a title, a topic and up to three versions; a version is a list of paragraphs with label, sentences[] and an optional topic {function, span, frame} pointing into email-expressions.json. Converted from the authored HTML in samples-formal.json / samples-informal.json: email-section blocks became labelled paragraphs, and each authored key-phrase span was matched back to the phrase bank so the topic anchor names a real function rather than a guess.
